question: By whose agency and will was the yoginī named Icchā established up to the realm of māyā?
premises: The extent reaches up to māyā by supreme will
inference: The yoginī named Icchā was established up to māyā by the siddhas through supreme will.
uncertainties: The main verb is implicit, likely carried from surrounding context.
plain_english: The yoginī named Icchā, by the siddhas and by supreme will, extends up to the limit of māyā.
